nodes.description: Payable fallback receive function that accepts Ether transfers; empty body.
External function bait(address _pickpocket) that delegatecalls into an attacker-supplied address and requires success.
Address parameter supplied by the caller; used as the target of a delegatecall.
delegatecall to attacker-controlled address _pickpocket with selector finesse(address); executes arbitrary external code in the context of Bait.
Boolean returned by the low-level delegatecall, checked by require(success).

edges.reason: Function bait declares and receives the caller-supplied parameter _pickpocket, making it available as the delegatecall target.
The unvalidated parameter _pickpocket flows directly into delegatecall, allowing arbitrary external code to execute in Bait's storage context (unprotected delegatecall / access control).
bait() unconditionally dispatches into the unsafe delegatecall with a caller-controlled address and no owner/permission check.
The delegatecall returns the success flag which is stored in the local variable success.
require(success) inside bait() conditionally reverts the transaction when the delegatecall fails.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is a pure carrier of the delegatecall target; it has no independent semantics beyond being consumed by the unsafe delegatecall, so it is merged into that unsafe_operation node.
The local variable is only the direct return value of the unsafe delegatecall and is immediately consumed by the require check, so it is merged into that unsafe_operation node.
